Forms

Stepper

Progress indicator for multi-step flows: enrollment, document upload, application review.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Stepper

Horizontal steppers stack vertically at 480 px and below so labels remain readable. Explicit orientation="vertical" stays vertical at every width.

Multi-step flow progress — matrícula, envio de documentos, inscrição em processo seletivo. Tells families how much is left, which is the main anxiety in an enrollment form.

<Stepper current={1} steps={[
  { label: 'Dados do aluno' },
  { label: 'Documentos', description: 'RG, CPF e comprovante' },
  { label: 'Confirmação' }
]} />
  • 3–5 steps; more than that means the flow needs splitting, not more dots.
  • Horizontal above the form on desktop; orientation="vertical" in a sidebar or on narrow screens.
  • Labels are nouns ("Documentos"), not instructions ("Envie seus documentos").

Plain HTML contract

The root is ol.rse-stepper; add .rse-stepper--vertical for a sidebar layout. Native attributes and the forwarded ref target the list. Each li.rse-stepper__step carries aria-current="step" when current and .rse-stepper__step--complete when completed. Use the vendored Icon check markup inside completed markers, with an accessible completed label.

<ol class="rse-stepper" aria-label="Etapas da matrícula">
  <li class="rse-stepper__step" aria-current="step">
    <div class="rse-stepper__track">
      <div class="rse-stepper__marker">1</div>
      <div class="rse-stepper__connector" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="rse-stepper__content">
      <div class="rse-stepper__label">Dados do aluno</div>
      <div class="rse-stepper__description">Informações iniciais</div>
    </div>
  </li>
  <li class="rse-stepper__step">
    <div class="rse-stepper__track"><div class="rse-stepper__marker">2</div></div>
    <div class="rse-stepper__content"><div class="rse-stepper__label">Documentos</div></div>
  </li>
</ol>

The last step has no connector. Static progress needs no JavaScript. To allow navigation, replace markers with button type="button", give each a label such as Etapa 1: Dados do aluno, and implement JavaScript to navigate the flow and update the current/completed state. The React wrapper calls onStepClick(index); the caller owns the current index and form validation.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
steps(string | StepperStep)[]yesStep labels, or objects with an optional description
currentnumber—Zero-based index of the current step; earlier steps render as complete
orientationhorizontal vertical—
onStepClick(index: number) => void—Makes step markers clickable (e.g. to revisit a completed step)

Also accepts every attribute of React.OlHTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>, a ref and className.
